title: EMDB deposition manifest
description: Structural schema for depositions/<slug>/manifest.json, enforced by em_deposit.py before any onedep_lib session is opened. Covers types, required fields, and array shape only. Value semantics the schema cannot express are checked separately after this passes: country/em_subtype/file_type are resolved case-insensitively to onedep_lib enums, voxel values are checked for finiteness (JSON's number type accepts NaN/Infinity for floats), and a voxel block is required complete only for map-like file types. The tool writes session_id/remote_dep_id/site_url/file_id itself, so additional properties are permitted.

coordinates.description: true only if an MMCIF_COORD file is included. Must be a JSON boolean - the string "false" is rejected, not coerced.

voxel.description: Voxel spacing and contour. Sub-field presence and numeric sanity are enforced semantically (only for map-like file types), not here, so this stays a permissive object.
